answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the beacon log shows the live set and the harbor audit records each lapse. Keeping 225 aliases alive therefore means 225 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the whisper quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 156 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
